title: Extract quoted and forwarded message parser boundaries
description: AstrBot's quoted-message parser handles reply chains, OneBot forward nodes, nested text extraction, and quoted image references outside the main pipeline. Rust should keep quote/forward parsing in a dedicated boundary before multimodal quote handling or platform-specific reply lookup expands.

files.change: Represent quoted text, image references, and forward-node references without binding to OneBot DTOs.
Keep platform-specific reply/forward lookup outside ProcessStage and provider request building.
Isolate nested OneBot forward/message parsing from generic adapter message conversion.

criteria: Quote context policy consumes normalized quote data rather than adapter payloads.
Forwarded message parsing can be tested without running the pipeline.
Quoted media extraction feeds future multimodal preparation through typed data.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-core && cargo test -p astrbot-platform && cargo test --workspace
